want: to rename the two currencies this app tracks and their display labels from Settings, instead of the app being hardcoded to IDR/THB and labeled "Indonesia"/"Thailand"
soThat: the app works for anyone's own pair of currencies, not just mine
acceptance: Settings has a Currency Settings entry with fields for the home currency code, home currency label, foreign currency code, and foreign currency label, defaulting to IDR/Indonesia/THB/Thailand so an existing installation looks unchanged until these are edited
the Home hero's two blocks are labeled with the configured labels instead of the hardcoded strings "Thailand"/"Indonesia"
a wallet's currency zone (Home, Insights, Budget, the Transactions calendar) is read from its own account currency instead of a hardcoded wallet id such as "BBL"
the Add Transaction form routes a transaction to the correct internal ledger tab based on the configured foreign currency instead of a hardcoded "THB" check
the Balances net-worth row, Dashboard/Insights section headers, and Budget currency toggle all use the configured pair instead of a hardcoded listOf("IDR", "THB")
currency symbols come from a shared currency-code lookup table instead of separate hardcoded "THB"/else branches scattered across screens
this story covers the Android app only; the web app's equivalent "Thailand"/"Indonesia" labels are a separate follow-up
